description: Schema for actor GLB mesh registration and physics capabilities profile submitted by client

maxSpeed.description: User-selected maximum speed in m/s, chosen at build time. No current tradeoff cost.

controller.description: Server movement controller. Ground=tracked/wheeled drive; hover=stabilized terrain-relative thrusters; aircraft=powered simplified flight; mecha=ground strafe/jump; boat=buoyancy at session waterLevel. See docs/physics-controls.md for supported axes and limitations.

physicsProfile.description: Build-time controller selection and maximum speed; other physics tuning is server-owned. No points budget.
